newsitem.title: JAPAN: Best Denki mulls buying stores from Yaohan.
newsitem.headline: Best Denki mulls buying stores from Yaohan.

text.p: Japanese consumer electronics retailer Best Denki Co Ltd said on Wednesday that it is considering buying 13 electrical appliance shops from units of Yaohan Japan Corp.
Best Denki said it is considering buying the 13 stores, currently operated by the Yaohan Japan units under a franchise agreement with Best Denki, for about 2.5 billion yen.
A spokesman for Yaohan Japan said it is in talks with Best Denki over the sale and the deal will likely be officially announced next week.
Yaohan Japan is currently restructuring its operations in the aim of improving its financial status.
The company aims to cut interest-bearing group debt to 90 billion yen from 164.6 billion yen over the next two years through the sale of stores, offices and a portion of its overseas assets.
